title: Kernel-based collocation methods for Heath-Jarrow-Morton models with Musiela parametrization
abstract: arXiv:1809.05643v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study kernel-based collocation methods for numerical solutions of Heath-Jarrow-Morton models in Musiela parametrization. The methods are Euler-Maruyama approximations of finite-dimensional stochastic differential equations and can be used with standard Monte Carlo procedures for derivative pricing. We give a conditional mean-square error estimate under explicit stability assumptions on the differentiated cardinal basis over the full evaluation region required by the volatility functional. The estimate uses the spatial-radius exponent dictated by the squared-error calculation. Two finite-resolution examples illustrate the method for a Vasicek model and for caplet pricing.

translated_title: 具有Musiela参数化的Heath-Jarrow-Morton模型的基于核的配置方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了基于核的配置方法，用于Musiela参数化下Heath-Jarrow-Morton模型的数值求解。这些方法是有限维随机微分方程的Euler-Maruyama近似，可与标准的蒙特卡洛程序结合用于衍生品定价。我们在对波动率泛函所要求的完整评估区域上的微分基数基函数施加显式稳定性假设的条件下，给出了条件均方误差估计。该估计采用了由平方误差计算所确定的空间半径指数。两个有限分辨率的算例分别演示了该方法在Vasicek模型和利率上限期权定价中的应用。
tldr: 本文提出了基于核的配置方法用于Musiela参数化下Heath-Jarrow-Morton模型的数值求解，在显式稳定性假设下给出了条件均方误差估计，并可结合蒙特卡洛方法应用于衍生品定价。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes kernel-based collocation methods for the numerical solution of Heath-Jarrow-Morton models in Musiela parametrization, providing a conditional mean-square error estimate under explicit stability assumptions, applicable to derivative pricing via Monte Carlo methods.
